global_theme.description: Warm, trustworthy merchant dashboard matching the exact orange/brown reference theme. Uses white cards on a light warm background, with a prominent dark card for recent payouts.

layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-orange-50 pb-20 relative shadow-xl overflow-hidden

MerchantHeader.container: flex flex-row justify-between items-start mb-6 pt-4 px-4 sm:px-6
MerchantHeader.title: text-xl font-bold text-stone-900
MerchantHeader.subtitle_pill: text-[10px] font-mono text-stone-500 bg-orange-100/50 px-2 py-1 rounded-md mt-1 inline-block

KPICard.container: bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-stone-100 flex flex-col justify-between h-24
KPICard.label: text-xs font-medium text-stone-500

DarkPayoutCard.container: bg-stone-800 p-5 rounded-3xl shadow-lg mx-4 sm:mx-6 mt-2 mb-6 text-white relative overflow-hidden
DarkPayoutCard.label: text-sm font-medium text-stone-300
DarkPayoutCard.button_primary: bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition-colors w-full text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-2
DarkPayoutCard.button_secondary: bg-transparent border border-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-700 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition-colors w-full text-center mt-2

FilterTabs.container: flex flex-row gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:px-6 pb-2 scrollbar-hide mb-4
FilterTabs.active_tab: bg-stone-900 text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap
FilterTabs.inactive_tab: bg-white text-stone-600 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-medium border border-stone-200 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors

TransactionItem.container: bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-stone-100 mb-3 mx-4 sm:mx-6 flex flex-row justify-between items-center
TransactionItem.icon_wrapper: w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-orange-50 flex items-center justify-center text-orange-600 mr-3 flex-shrink-0
TransactionItem.title: text-sm font-bold text-stone-900

BottomNav.container: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white border-t border-stone-100 px-6 py-3 flex flex-row justify-between items-center z-40 pb-safe
BottomNav.item_inactive: flex flex-col items-center text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600 transition-colors
BottomNav.label: text-[10px] mt-1 font-medium

DUXIQChatModal.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-stone-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex flex-col justify-end
DUXIQChatModal.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-2xl pb-safe flex flex-col h-[85vh] overflow-hidden relative
DUXIQChatModal.header: p-4 border-b border-stone-100 flex justify-between items-center bg-orange-50
DUXIQChatModal.message_area: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 flex flex-col gap-4
DUXIQChatModal.message_user: bg-orange-100 text-stone-900 p-3 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm self-end max-w-[80%] text-sm shadow-sm
DUXIQChatModal.message_ai: bg-stone-50 border border-stone-100 text-stone-900 p-3 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm self-start max-w-[80%] text-sm shadow-sm
DUXIQChatModal.proactive_chip: bg-white border border-orange-200 text-orange-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap shadow-sm active:bg-orange-50 cursor-pointer
DUXIQChatModal.input_area: p-4 border-t border-stone-100 flex gap-2 items-center bg-white
DUXIQChatModal.star_icon: w-6 h-6 text-stone-300 hover:text-orange-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure standard React JS with Tailwind classes mapped exactly to this JSON. Ensure it's responsive but restricted to 'max-w-md mx-auto' to perfectly mimic the mobile app layout on standard web browsers.
Implement exact values for all mock data as specified in the problem statement (Barista Coffee, ₹2,450.00, etc.).
DO NOT use a full screen width layout; encapsulate the app inside 'max-w-md mx-auto'.
Implement the DUX IQ chat as a fixed bottom-sheet modal using standard React state, overlaying the UI.
Inside the chat modal, mock a conversation flow: user asks query -> AI suggests proactive chips -> AI asks 'Did this resolve your issue?' -> User clicks No -> Ticket created -> Star rating shown.
Apply all data-testids to the interactive elements exactly as specified in the test_ids object.
Include Lucide React or Phosphor React icons for the Bottom Navigation, Transaction items, and Chat interface.
The Dark Payout Card must use 'bg-stone-800' to accurately reflect the dark theme requirement from the reference image.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. If needed, use standard Shadcn UI components. Ensure no complex setup is required for the chat flow.
